persistence.migration: First successful save publishes an encrypted index only after all new encrypted records are durable; preserves original encrypted V1 bytes as state.legacy.enc
persistence.recovery: Current and previous index references survive garbage collection; missing index, missing bodies, invalid identity and authentication errors reject reads instead of creating empty history
persistence.backup: Copy the entire local-agent directory and preserve original credential key; legacy backup contains only the migration-time state
persistence.ownership: AgentService writeQueue serializes snapshots. Per-process publication lanes and a previous-state comparison reject stale sessions; this is not a cross-process transaction lock.
